title: Electride support boosts nitrogen dissociation over ruthenium catalyst and shifts the bottleneck in ammonia synthesis
extraction_notes: No main-text plotted NH3 synthesis performance data were digitised under the requested rules. Figure 3a is an Arrhenius plot (ln rate vs 1/T) and was skipped. Figures 3b and 3c are reaction-order plots (ln rate vs ln partial pressure) and were skipped. Other main-text figures are energy profiles, DFT/mechanistic schematics, or hydrogen incorporation/desorption measurements rather than measured NH3 synthesis rate, outlet NH3 concentration, or TOF plots.
